biography:
I am charged with global business development for T5 Data Centers. While always promoting T5 Data Centers' portfolio of owned data centers, I've recently begun focusing primarily on growing T5's "third-party" service offerings: T5 Facilities Management and T5 Construction Services.

"T5 Facilities Management" is a best-in-class service that maintains and operates all T5 owned facilities, and is also a third-party offering available to the data center industry.  T5 Facilities Management is an industry leader developing proprietary processes and procedures that have garnered the Uptime Institute's prestigious "Continuous Availability Award" at multiple facilities.  

"T5 Construction Services" provides construction services for data center owners and tenants across North America.  As a contractor/developer of our owned T5 data centers, we're equipped to handle new projects, upgrades, or retrofits of 3rd-party facilities in a collaborative manner.

"T5 Data Centers" offers data center facilities for lease, sale, or build-to-suit in key markets across North America and Europe.  We offer single-tenant "stand alone" enterprise data centers and secure "data suites" available within our wholesale data center portfolio.  We also offer a Global Build-To-Suit Program in which T5 will fund the construction of 100% Turnkey data centers or Powered Shells for end-users in qualified locations.
